svg.title: Fantasy map of the Western Reaches
svg.desc: A hand-inked fantasy map of the Western Reaches draws itself: coastlines, mountain ranges, forests, rivers and lettered place names. Then the view zooms in on the village of Bramblecott and follows a dashed red route east past the Ford of Glass, Elderhall, the Gate of Teeth and Ashfall to the smoking Mount Cinder, before pulling back to the whole map.
